shellCommands.command: git status --short; cat package.json; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | head -100

for f in lib/data.ts next.config.ts app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; git diff; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -ril "prefetch" . | head -30; echo; grep -rl "unstable_instant\|runtime prefetch\|unstable_prefetch" . | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md; ls 02-guides | grep -i -e prefetch -e instant

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; sed -n 1,200p 03-api-reference/04-functions/navigation.md; echo ====; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "navigation()\|prefetch={true}" 02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | head -150
